notes.title: Massive Public Demo Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]FREE Demo Update! [/h1]

Surprise! We have released a new version of the MY FAMILIAR public demo!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41743261/46c243cfff7f13e33a5953a1e3ebffc820ec390a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41743261/c0c5369b9057649a63b21835bed5918381fd00b3.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41743261/dd90bad35a59a2acdd9fa85028e8bb4c74b8ecca.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41743261/79385e714110a9a556d6b9931eac5cca785ccd1e.jpg[/img]

And of course, here are some teasers of what you can expect in the very near future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41743261/6a21ea38e41223da05fb973b1eafa9ac5e20eb1d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41743261/cc29329d4170984be7743bef2e2c4476450914d3.jpg[/img]

[h2]Official Patch Notes:[/h2]
[h3]New Content:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New side quests in TWINKLE ROW
[*] Rose Items to tweak hero stats
[*] New CHARGED HIT effect for Teryx
[*] Cutscene Skip Button
[/list]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
- Crows can no longer crash the game if a seagull randomly flies into them offscreen
- Improved HUD targeting UI
- Fixed bug where NPCs will sometimes moonwalk
- Certain equipment now updates Max HP/SP as expected
- Fixed a softlock if you lose a battle (why did you lose? Get more DOPE hits!)
- Fixed a game crash in the Pause Menu
- HEADACHE ability now prevents Abilities as expected
- Fixed layering issues when a hero is DEAD
- DEAD Hero is now removed from action queue
- Fixed an issue where abilities that applied multiple buffs were not being applied
- Improved SP Damage visuals
- Fixed bug where SkipHurt command was being ignored
- Magic Damage now inherits elemental properties
- Fixed bugs involving Multihit Projectiles
- Fixed bug where a retargeted multi-hit would ignore shield
- Fixed bug where heroes have incorrect placards when DEAD
- Improved visual messaging for Bonus Round Timeline
- Fixed bug with the Pause Menu Smearing/Masking
- Fixed enemy chase icon depth sorting
- Fixed certain OnDeath Trigger effects

notes.title: PAX East Rising Showcase & Demo Update 0.30.0!
notes.notes:
Hello all Familiars!

[h2]PAX East Rising Showcase[/h2]

We have some big news to share! First, My Familiar won a spot at the PAX East Rising Showcase! Check us out on the official page [url=https://east.paxsite.com/en-us/features/pax-rising-showcase.html]here[/url]!

If you are attending PAX East (March 21, 2024 - March 24, 2024), be sure to swing by the showcase area to meet the team! The PAX East Rising Showcase will be at Booth 13097 (or just follow the signs!)

[h2]Demo Updated to 0.30.0![/h2]

We have also updated the public demo build of MY FAMILIAR to version 0.30.0!

[list]
[*] NEW Content: Play through the MY FAMILIAR prologue!
[*] Added Config Menu
[*] Balance tweaks to the Timed Hit timing
[*] Added Ally Followers!
[*] New Choices UI and tweaks to the dialogue system,
[*] Bug: Countless bug fixes involving doors
[*] Bug: Countless fixes involving depth sorting and layering
[*] Bug: Fixed numerous soft-locks and game crashes
[*] ...plus countless other fixes and changes!
[/list]

[h2]Join the Discord![/h2]
As always, we invite you to join the [url=https://discord.gg/somethingclassic]Discord[/url]!

Best,

- Ty

notes.title: Demo updated to 0.2.0!
notes.notes:
Hello, all!

We have updated the My Familiar demo to version [i]0.2.0-DEMO[/i]. This update includes many bug fixes, polish and a major new feature: Timed Hits! You can see a full changelog of the changes below:

[list]
[*] Added Timed hits. Certain attacks will now deal more damage if you time your inputs correctly
[*] Added ally follower. Once you gain additional team members they will now follow you in the overworld
[*] Added environmental sparkles that give items when interacted with
[*] Added more treasure
[*] Any item not purchased from the Ibexa Shop is now distributed randomly in the world.
[*] Fixed rare crash when entering the diner
[*] Fixed bugs relating to player facing/animating the wrong direction in cutscenes
[*] Fixed bug where player could enter Twinklerow early
[*] Fixed some ui elements not appearing on certain screen resolutions
[*] Added version number to title screen
[*] Many more bug fixes
[/list]

As always, thank you for playing My Familiar! If you encounter any issues, feel free to join our active Discord community: https://discord.gg/somethingclassic.

Cheers,


- Ty

notes.title: My Familiar Demo Launch + Update!
notes.notes:
The My Familiar Demo has launched! We did a silent launch on February 13, 2023 here on Steam and now we are making it official with our first Demo Update!

[b]Demo Update Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] macOS Support added (Catalina and up!)
[*] Native Linux/SteamOS Support added! (Ubuntu/SteamOS)
[*] Improved Audio Balancing
[*] Fixed bug where audio could stop after the Chugdealer encounter
[*] Fixed bug where Kato wouldn't revive player in the first boss fight (soft-lock)
[*] Initiative changes now preview correctly when equipping accessories
[*] Resistance changes now preview correctly when equipping accessories
[*] Fixed Item Drop SFX playing multiple times
[*] Fixed Garage Door opening behind player
[*] Fixed audio looping issues with variant looping tracks
[*] Fixed bug where music would resume after being stopped by a cutscene
[*] Fixed music start timing in Apartment and Garage
[*] Linux: Fixed save paths were double nesting
[/list]

When you've played the demo, please let us know your feedback by filling out this form: [url=https://forms.gle/pxQC2x1MAVsSkwRw5]https://forms.gle/pxQC2x1MAVsSkwRw5[/url]

If you want to follow development of My Familiar, please join our official Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/somethingclassic]https://discord.gg/somethingclassic[/url]

Or follow us on Twitter:
[url=https://twitter.com/MyFamiliarRPG]https://twitter.com/MyFamiliarRPG[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/SomethingClassc]https://twitter.com/SomethingClassc[/url]

Game on,


- Ty

notes.title: A demon rat and a duck star in this buddy cop RPG
notes.notes: JRPG oddity has made its way onto Steam, an comedic fantasy buddy cop RPG that's about some weird, extremely asocial demons battling in a city falling down around their ears. You're a trashy rat creature, you have no idea what's going on, and your job is to climb a tower—but you'll need to make some friends (and enemies) to get there... Read more.
